purpose: Preserve the complete causal history of JANUS algorithm research so TOPA+Spider can reconstruct lineage, detect forgotten mechanisms, duplicated failures, cross-era invariants and post-result lessons without relying on narrative memory.
append_only_law: Previously frozen entries are never rewritten to improve a later interpretation. Corrections and reinterpretations must be new entries linked by supersedes_or_corrects.

journal_disciplines.pre_registration: Separate hypotheses frozen before outcome inspection from post-result interpretation.
journal_disciplines.negative_results: Failures, UNKNOWN states, resource limits, dead ends and failed architectural transfers must be logged with the same priority as successes.
journal_disciplines.raw_state: Store full typed exact state/provenance references when available; scalar summaries such as epsilon or fingerprints are never sufficient as the sole record.
journal_disciplines.costs: Charge discovery, projection, canonicalization, serialization, provenance, lookup, memory, verification and total compute where applicable.
journal_disciplines.open_frontier: Every OPEN/UNKNOWN entry should preserve the frozen frontier witness and capability digest when available.
journal_disciplines.adaptive_learning: Current-episode outcomes may inform future journal analysis but cannot retroactively change current-episode authority or frozen gates.
journal_disciplines.spider_layering: TOPA+Spider associations are advisory evidence graph edges, never proof authority.
journal_disciplines.dead_path_memory: Refuted mechanisms remain discoverable so JANUS does not later rediscover them as apparently new ideas.

preferred_storage.meta_registry: one pointer/checkpoint per major journal epoch
